messages.subject: unexplained error plotlyOutput
parts:
Hi group,

An app I loaded this weekend runs fine on my local machine. It built OK, but when I launch the instance on shiny.io, I get an error; "could not find the function 'plotlyOutput'."

As everyone knows, this is the function in ui.R to output a plotly chart.

Far as I know I'm running the latest package versions, so I don't think that's it.

Advice?
